title: EventEnvelope v1
description: Common envelope carried by every corebank-lite event. P1 services and the aml-monitor component rely on these fields for deduplication, tracing and audit.

eventId.description: Unique id of this event. Consumers deduplicate on it (processed_events).

eventType.description: Logical event name, for example AccountOpened.

schemaVersion.description: Major version of the event schema. Always equals the topic's version suffix.

occurredAt.description: UTC instant at which the business fact happened.

correlationId.description: Ties together every event caused by the same request.

actorUserId.description: User or system principal that triggered the event.
